name: The Inkosi and the traditional council
note: Holds the trust land. Cannot be bought, and notices when you only visit before you need something.

name: District municipality
note: Signs the permissions. Slow, and slower when the ward committee is unhappy.

note: Not a monolith. Moderates the rate at which trust decays.
